description: This file defines a Flutter widget called HomeShell which manages navigation between two screens: BooksScreen and TransactionsScreen. It uses a BottomNavigationBar to switch between these screens, and updates the app bar title dynamically based on the selected page.

classes.name: HomeShell
classes.description: A StatefulWidget serving as the main shell for the home screen, providing navigation between Books and Transactions screens.

classes.name: _HomeShellState
classes.description: State class managing the current index and which screen to display, building the Scaffold with AppBar, body, and BottomNavigationBar.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for the HomeShell widget.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the HomeShell, including AppBar, body with AnimatedSwitcher, and BottomNavigationBar.

methods.name: <anonymous>
methods.description: The onTap callback for BottomNavigationBar that updates the current index state.
